speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A playhouse yard is two thousand people gathered by a flag.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not saying it to Gillis. I am not saying it to her. There is no one in the room to say it to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The heading is on the tables. Unlawful assemblies, in or about the City. Greenwich, this fourth of July. Wilford to see it done. The two at the post had a wedding, and they had not read past the first lines, and I left them there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow I come home from Shoreditch by Bishopsgate Street. Not by the fields.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing is decided. The house is not shut. I have not told John the two thousand. Enough.
